_comment: Generated by tools/patrons/gen_patrons.js - do not hand-edit. `secret` is the slot's world square and hatch tile, encrypted under a key derived from those coordinates; the game opens it by trying the square it is already generating. A slot with a blank `id` is RESERVED for a future patron: its square is already rolled, but the game skips it (no hatch, no room, no planet) until it is named. See js/plugins/Crafting/PatreonRewards.js.
